title: Lyra melee combo with early and late cancel
description:
Unreal for Animators workshop at iAnimate: https://ianimate.net/workshops/unreal-for-animators

A full 3-hit melee combo system in Unreal Engine 5.7 on Lyra: early and late cancel windows, jog locomotion, jump attack, rush attack and dodge roll.
